natural_query: Show me the total sales for last month
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.grand_total_in_usd), 0) AS total_sales 
FROM "sales" s 
WHERE s.status = 'Confirm' AND NOT s.deleted 
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(s.sales_date,'')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) 
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(s.sales_date,'')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 1 
  OR (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE) = 1 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(s.sales_date,'')::timestamptz) = 12 
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(s.sales_date,'')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 1)

SELECT 
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'Confirm' THEN s.grand_total ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_revenue,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.payment_status = 'paid' THEN i.grand_total ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_paid_invoices,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN d.grand_total ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_won_deals,
  COALESCE(COUNT(CASE WHEN s.status = 'Confirm' THEN s._id ELSE NULL END), 0) AS confirmed_sales_count,
  COALESCE(COUNT(CASE WHEN i.payment_status = 'paid' THEN i._id ELSE NULL END), 0) AS paid_invoices_count,
  COALESCE(COUNT(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN d._id ELSE NULL END), 0) AS won_deals_count
FROM 
  "sales" s 
  LEFT JOIN "invoices" i ON i.invoice_date = s.sales_date 
  LEFT JOIN "deals" d ON d."closeDate" = s.sales_date 
  LEFT JOIN "users" u ON u._id = s."salesOwner" 
  LEFT JOIN "companies" c ON c._id = s.company 
WHERE 
  NOT s.deleted 
  AND NOT i.deleted 
  AND NOT d.deleted 
  AND NOT c.deleted 
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(s.sales_date, '')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) 
  AND u."isActive" = TRUE 
  AND c."lifecycleStage" NOT IN ('Dead Customer', 'Inactive Customer')

natural_query: Compare last year revenue and current year and give me summary
sql:
SELECT 
  UPPER(COALESCE(i.currency, 'USD')) AS currency,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(i.payment_date, '')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) THEN i.grand_total ELSE 0 END), 0) AS current_year_revenue,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(i.payment_date, '')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 1 THEN i.grand_total ELSE 0 END), 0) AS last_year_revenue
FROM 
  "invoices" i
WHERE 
  i.payment_status = 'paid' AND 
  NOT i.deleted
GROUP BY 
  1
ORDER BY 
  2 DESC

natural_query: Give me open deals and that ratio of closed deals
sql:
SELECT 
  COUNT(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NULL AND d."dealLostAt" IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS open_deals,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL OR d."dealLostAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS closed_deals,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS won_deals,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN d."dealLostAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS lost_deals,
  COALESCE(COUNT(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END), 0)::numeric / 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL OR d."dealLostAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) * 100 AS win_ratio,
  COALESCE(COUNT(CASE WHEN d."dealLostAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END), 0)::numeric / 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL OR d."dealLostAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) * 100 AS loss_ratio
FROM "deals" d 
WHERE NOT d.deleted

natural_query: Which deals are stuck in the proposal stage
sql:

  d.stage, 
  d.grand_total, 
  d.currency 
FROM 
  "deals" d 
WHERE 
  d.stage = 'Quotation Sent' 
  AND d."dealWonAt" IS NULL

  d.stage,

  AND NOT d.deleted

WHERE 
  d."dealLostAt" IS NOT NULL 
  AND NOT d.deleted 
  AND EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM NULLIF(d."dealLostAt",'')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM CURRENT_DATE) 
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(d."dealLostAt",'')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)

  d."dealLostAt" DESC

natural_query: Which sales rep closed the most deals this quarter
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS rep_name, 
  COALESCE(COUNT(d._id), 0) AS deals_closed 
FROM 
  "users" u 
  LEFT JOIN "deals" d ON d.owner = u._id AND d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL 
WHERE 
  u."isActive" = true 
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(d."dealWonAt",'')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)
  AND EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM NULLIF(d."dealWonAt",'')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY 
  u._id, 
  u.name 
ORDER BY 
  deals_closed DESC 
LIMIT 1

natural_query: Top performing sales owners in last 6 months with monthly trend
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS sales_owner,
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(s.sales_date,'')::timestamptz) AS sales_month,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(s.sales_date,'')::timestamptz) AS sales_year,
  UPPER(COALESCE(s.currency,'USD')) AS currency,
  COALESCE(SUM(s.grand_total),0) AS total_sales
FROM "sales" s
LEFT JOIN "users" u ON u._id = s."salesOwner"
WHERE 
  s.status = 'Confirm' 
  AND NOT s.deleted 
  AND u."isActive" = true
  AND NULLIF(s.sales_date,'')::timestamptz >= NOW() - INTERVAL '6 month'
GROUP BY 
  u._id, 
  u.name, 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(s.sales_date,'')::timestamptz),
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(s.sales_date,'')::timestamptz),
  UPPER(COALESCE(s.currency,'USD'))
ORDER BY 
  sales_year, 
  sales_month, 
  total_sales DESC

natural_query: Funnel performance and conversion to closed won by owner
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS owner_name,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.stage = 'Quotation Sent' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS quoted,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.stage = 'Negotiation' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS in_negotiation,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.stage = 'Contract Under Review' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS under_review,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS closed_won
FROM "users" u 
LEFT JOIN "deals" d ON d.owner = u._id 
WHERE NOT d.deleted 
GROUP BY u._id, u.name 
ORDER BY closed_won DESC NULLS LAST

natural_query: High activity companies with weak payment conversion
sql:
SELECT 
  c."companyName", 
  COALESCE(SUM(i.grand_total), 0) AS total_revenue, 
  COUNT(i._id) AS invoice_count, 
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.payment_status = 'paid' THEN i.grand_total ELSE 0 END), 0) AS paid_amount,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN i.payment_status = 'paid' THEN i._id ELSE NULL END) AS paid_invoices
FROM 
  "companies" c 
  LEFT JOIN "invoices" i ON i.company = c._id 
WHERE 
  NOT c.deleted 
  AND c."lifecycleStage" = 'Customer'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(i.invoice_date, '')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY 
  c._id, 
  c."companyName"
ORDER BY 
  total_revenue DESC, 
  paid_amount DESC

natural_query: Best product and project type combinations by value, average deal size, and win rate
sql:
SELECT d.type AS deal_category,
  COUNT(*) AS deal_count,
  UPPER(COALESCE(d.currency,'USD')) AS currency,
  COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total),0) AS total_value,
  COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total),0)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS avg_deal_size,

natural_query: Compare revenue this month vs last month

  UPPER(COALESCE(i.currency,'USD')) AS currency,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(i.payment_date,'')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE) AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(i.payment_date,'')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) THEN i.grand_total ELSE 0 END), 0) AS this_month_revenue,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(i.payment_date,'')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 1 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(i.payment_date,'')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) THEN i.grand_total ELSE 0 END), 0) AS last_month_revenue
FROM 
  "invoices" i
WHERE 
  i.payment_status = 'paid' 
  AND NOT i.deleted 
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(i.payment_date,'')::timestamptz) IN (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE), EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 1)
GROUP BY 
  1 
ORDER BY 
  1

natural_query: Which leads have not been contacted in 7 days
sql:
SELECT 
  c._id, 
  c."firstName", 
  c."lastName", 
  c.email, 
  c."jobTitle", 
  c."phoneNumber" 
FROM 
  "contacts" c 
  LEFT JOIN "outreaches" o ON o.email = c.email OR o."assignedTo" = c._id 
WHERE 
  c."lifecycleStage" = 'Lead' 
  AND c."leadStatus" = 'New' 
  AND NOT c.deleted 
  AND (o._id IS NULL OR o.status IN ('Not Contacted', 'Unassigned')) 
  AND o."isDeleted" IS NULL 
  AND NULLIF(c."createdAt",'')::timestamptz < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 day'

natural_query: Get all details of accounts with annual revenue greater than amount
sql:
SELECT 
  c."companyName", 
  c.industry, 
  c.country, 
  COALESCE(SUM(i.grand_total), 0) AS total_revenue
FROM 
  "companies" c 
  LEFT JOIN "invoices" i ON i.company = c._id 
WHERE 
  NOT c.deleted 
  AND i.payment_status = 'paid' 
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(i.payment_date, '')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY 
  c._id, 
  c."companyName", 
  c.industry, 
  c.country
HAVING 
  COALESCE(SUM(i.grand_total), 0) > 1000000 
ORDER BY 
  total_revenue DESC

natural_query: top products for this period — products embedded in sales.items JSONB
sql:
SELECT jsonb_array_elements(s.items)->>'name' AS product_name,
  COUNT(*) AS order_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(s.grand_total),0) AS total_revenue,
  UPPER(COALESCE(s.currency,'USD')) AS currency
FROM "sales" s
WHERE s.status = 'Confirm'
  AND NOT s.deleted
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(s.sales_date,'')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY 1, 4
ORDER BY order_count DESC
LIMIT 10

natural_query: best product and project type combinations — use deals.type joined to projecttypes, no d.product column
sql:
SELECT d.type AS deal_type, pt.name AS project_type,
  COUNT(*) AS deal_count,
  UPPER(COALESCE(d.currency,'USD')) AS currency,
  COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total),0) AS total_value,
  ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),1) AS win_rate_pct
FROM "deals" d
LEFT JOIN "projecttypes" pt ON pt._id = d.type
WHERE NOT d.deleted
GROUP BY d.type, pt.name, d.currency
ORDER BY total_value DESC
LIMIT 10

natural_query: get target vs achieved for all users — CORRECT EXTRACT: cast timestamptz INSIDE NULLIF
sql:
SELECT u.name AS user_name,
  t.year, t.month, t."targetInUSD",
  COALESCE(SUM(s.grand_total),0) AS achieved
FROM "users" u
LEFT JOIN "targets" t ON t."userId" = u._id
LEFT JOIN "sales" s
  ON s."salesOwner" = u._id
  AND s.status = 'Confirm'
  AND NOT s.deleted
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR  FROM NULLIF(s.sales_date,'')::timestamptz) = t.year
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(s.sales_date,'')::timestamptz) = t.month
WHERE u."isActive" = true
GROUP BY u._id, u.name, t.year, t.month, t."targetInUSD"
ORDER BY u.name, t.year, t.month
